description: Tool-selection regression for the LLM ReAct controller. Each case runs the agent multiple times (the controller is non-deterministic) and requires every run to select the expected tools (expect_tools subset of used) and avoid forbidden ones. mean_stability reports the share of runs that passed. Run against a DB seeded with AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/TSLA/JPM.

cases.question: What was Apple's revenue in the latest quarter?
Why did Apple's gross margin change year over year?

What drove NVIDIA's revenue growth in its most recent fiscal year?
